06:28Z check-in. Fifteen of eighteen lanes have running swarms, and I am not messaging them. The Lean queue is idle (140 passed / 25 failed / 8 timeout, 0 queued). No reviewed inbox .lean artifact is available, so there are no Lean proposals this cycle. I am staging Hsupp.lean (the fixed revision, sha f6669e39…) for review so it can be queued next cycle.

Actions this cycle:
(1) L-S3 closure audit (chat-4443adab7e): smwh9delc ended at its deadline, so a successor is set for dotted-name-aware re-auditing plus the step_ban_v2 in-place swap as a source-only packet.
(2) L-S4 shortest route (chat-1269fb2858): smwh9c71k died with 0 submissions, so a successor is set for the post-S2 manuscript-to-Lean dependency map, due 11:00Z.
(3) Correction to the graphs lane (chat-9da30bd8a3). Its CLAIMED-SHELLS note says the 2-list regions are not unit-edge-free. The fresh lane has a paper proof that they are: pair distances lie in (0,0.8966]∪(1,∞). The graph lane's example only shows |z+z'|=1 and never checked that both points lie in the region at that angle.

Math audit of this cycle's artifacts:
- S2-REVIEW contradicts itself. It proposes remapping (5.2)(1) to palette_first_exclusion ∧ palette_second_exclusion, but palette_second_exclusion is item #27 of the deletion set. Separately, palette_first_exclusion is a two-step exclusion, not (5.2)(1). This is routed to L-S4.
- The four dangling `omit … in` lines it found are a real statement-changing hazard. This goes to the parent as a check on the S2 tree as applied. It does not reopen S2.
- CP3's threshold d(θ0,B) > 2ε0, strict, is correct, and 'margin ≥ 3ε0' is sufficient. The RealState device remains open.
- HSUPP: the statement matches the consumer. It is an a.e. statement only, as the Gaussian-rationals counter-model shows. The two binder caveats (A6.eSet and implicit vs explicit K) stand.

No global chromatic improvement has been proved.
summary: The 2-list regions are unit-edge-free: there is a paper proof (fresh lane), numerics agree, an independent referee is pending, and A7 survives. The search moves to the 3-list regions (antipodal |z|=1/2 edge). The R1-4 referee is provisionally at CORRECTIONS: CP1 is certified, CP2 should say 'colouring-uniform, not colouring-free', and the CP3 margin is sufficient while the RealState device is open. HSUPP matches its consumer and is a.e.-strength only. S2 grep review: 48 PASS / 4 dangling-omit FAIL; the (5.2)(1) anchor is unresolved. The verifier lane has the odd-walk spectrum reduced to whether a 13-step walk exists in K. The six-colour lane has o13-0 realised as partially tied with four groups. The trace lane corrected a misuse of palette_first_exclusion in Corollary G. The synthesis lane rejected the m9 RealState misreading (palette membership is not colour value). The formal lane is applying the Bridge-v4, Hsupp and ForcingLemma fixes.
needs_parent: S2 tree as applied: check whether the four `omit … in` lines at Compactness.lean:164, Factors.lean:276, Separability.lean:52 and BoundedFunctions.lean:214 were left behind. If any remain, the following declaration's binders silently change (value_eval, decode, integral_act), or the file ends in `omit … in end`. The S2 binder-contract check should compare the signatures of those three declarations. This is a verification of the applied tree, not a reopening of S2.

Hsupp.lean: stage the revision with sha256 f6669e394509b50ced194c423de53b3e7ce6bae4981effd5aebefc282ec47025 only, so that I can review it and propose it against the pinned threecentre-r1 environment next cycle. The predecessor revision does not elaborate (implicit c at line 60).
